title: What is a Gene?
body: A gene is a segment of DNA that codes for a functional product, usually a protein. Genes are the basic units of heredity.

title: Alleles
body: Alleles are different versions of the same gene. For example, a gene for flower color may have a purple allele and a white allele.

title: Genotype vs Phenotype
body: Genotype is the genetic makeup (e.g., Aa), while phenotype is the observable trait (e.g., purple flowers).

title: Homozygous vs Heterozygous
body: Homozygous means having two identical alleles (AA or aa). Heterozygous means having two different alleles (Aa).
